title: Brasileirão 30th Round Stirs Title and Relegation Battles
subtitle: Direct clashes and regional derbies promise to define the course of the Brazilian Championship table.
excerpt: The Brasileirão's 30th round features classics like Fla-Flu, Gre-Nal, and the Derby, plus crucial matches in the fight against relegation.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The 30th round of the Brazilian Championship is underway, with matches over the weekend and on Monday. Regional derbies and direct clashes in the title race and against relegation promise to shake up the table. This intense scenario of disputes is what drives the search for information about Brasileirão matches.

The Decisive Round of the Brazilian Championship

The 30th round of the Brazilian Championship arrives with regional derbies and clashes that promise to shake up the competition. There are seven games over the weekend and three on Monday. The fight for the lead and at the bottom of the table is intense. The highlights of the round are the duels Flamengo vs Fluminense, Grêmio vs Internacional, and Palmeiras vs Corinthians.

Derbies That Can Change the Title Race

Two of the round's derbies are considered decisive and could influence the leadership race. Flamengo needs to beat Fluminense to avoid the risk of losing the top spot. Palmeiras, on the other hand, must defeat Corinthians to remain solely dependent on themselves to be champions. In the clash between Atlético Mineiro and Santos, there is a balance in predictions, with three votes for each team and two bets on a draw. Flamengo, in the derby against Fluminense, has a draw as the most voted result, with four predictions, while Palmeiras receives six predictions to beat Corinthians. In the Gre-Nal, Grêmio received five votes, against two for Internacional and one for a draw.

The Intense Fight Against Relegation

The bottom of the table also features important clashes. Grêmio and Internacional, for example, are in the relegation zone, with Grêmio in 18th place with 30 points and Internacional in 17th with 31. Both need parallel results and a victory in the derby to try to escape the zone. Their direct adversaries, Mirassol (15th with 33 points) and Corinthians (16th with 32 points), will have complicated away games. Corinthians faces Palmeiras, while Mirassol plays against Bahia, a team fighting for a spot in the Libertadores. Other teams near the relegation zone, such as Vasco (14th place) hosting Remo on Saturday (10), and Botafogo (13th) playing against Coritiba on Monday (12), will also have their performances closely watched.

Other Important Clashes of the Round

In addition to the derbies and direct relegation battles, the round features other significant duels. Vasco, hosting Remo, is predicted as the winner by all participants in an analysis. Athletico-PR, visiting Chapecoense, is also seen as victorious. In the clash between Bahia and Mirassol, the Tricolor has seven predictions in its favor. São Paulo vs Vitória has the São Paulo Tricolor with six votes, against two for a draw. Finally, Bragantino vs Cruzeiro has Cruzeiro with five predictions in its favor. Two participants believe in a draw, while one predicts a Bragantino victory. The match between Coritiba and Botafogo also shows balance, with three predictions for Botafogo to win, three for a draw, and two for the Paraná team.

Predictions and Analyses for the Duels

Detailed analyses highlight the importance of each match. In the game between Vasco and Remo, Vasco could achieve its fifth consecutive victory. São Paulo needs to beat Vitória, relying on their record of never having been defeated by the opponent at Morumbi. Atlético Mineiro plays at home against Santos, and the evolution of the teams might help the coastal team take a point back. In the Gre-Nal, Grêmio's last victory was precisely in the Copa do Brasil classic, six matches ago. For Palmeiras and Corinthians, the Derby is decisive for both ends of the table. Flamengo, in turn, may have increased favoritism against Fluminense, who might rest players thinking about the Libertadores semifinals. Bahia needs to get back to winning ways after two consecutive defeats against Mirassol, who has an extra day of rest.

With information from ge, UOL, GZH.
